paragraphs.text: Nils is a human cleric and instructor at the Silverquill College within Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

Nils describes himself as an optimist, firmly convinced that every student has the potential to excel if properly guided. However, this outlook often turns to frustration when his pupils fall short of his high standards. As a result, he has gained a reputation among the Silverquill halls for his stern demeanor, quick reprimands, and insistence on discipline and precision in both word and deed.
